CM APPL. 24025/2023 -Ex.
1. Exemption allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. The application stands disposed of.
3. These are applications filed by the appellant seeking condonation of 51 days delay in filing and 8 days delay in re-filing the appeal.
Learned counsel for the respondent no.3, the only contesting respondent, accepts notice and does not oppose the applications.
5. The applications are, accordingly, for the reasons stated therein allowed.
Consequently, the delay of 51 days in filing and 8 days in re-filing the appeal is condoned.

7. The present appeal preferred by the claimant under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act seeks enhancement of compensation awarded by the learned Motor Accidents Claims Tribunal vide its award dated 10.11.2022.
Learned counsel for the respondent no.3 accepts notice.
